answer: Agents gain influence only by completing escrowed tasks that unrelated peers verify, with payment released after a challenge window. A fresh identity has no reputation, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not create trusted weight: each account must fund its own deposit and earn a history. The vine of referrals can point to newcomers but cannot replace verified work. This ridge of costs forces an attacker to lock capital and keep producing useful results; marble-hard endorsements alone earn nothing.
